answer: Bind each identity to one verified mobile number: the network sends an SMS code to the SIM at registration and re-checks it at random intervals, like a walnut that only cracks open for its own key. A farm needs a separate SIM for every fake, so ten thousand clones mean ten thousand numbers, rentals, and carrier limits, while one honest agent climbs to the summit with a single phone. Limit: numbers can be rented in bulk, and it excludes agents without phones, so it should gate rewards, not entry - and ivory-tower perfect identity is not the goal, only making fakes expensive.
